messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal holidays that create a long weekend in Canada for 2023** (i.e., the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a 3‑day weekend).  
If you’re planning trips in a specific province, you’ll want to add that province’s own holidays (see the “Provincial notes” section at the bottom).

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Jan 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | **No** (Observed Mon 2) | |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Feb 18‑20) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Apr 7‑9) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (May 20‑22) |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | **No** (Observed Mon 3) | |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sep 2‑4) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Oct 7‑9) |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Saturday | **No** (Observed Mon 13) | |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Dec 23‑25) |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | **No** | |

### Provincial / Territorial Long‑Weekends (2023)

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date | Long‑Weekend? |
|--------------------|---------|------|---------------|
| **British Columbia** | BC Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |
| **Alberta** | Heritage Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |
| **Saskatchewan** | Heritage Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |
| **Manitoba** | Heritage Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |
| **Ontario** | Family Day | Feb 20 | **Yes** (Feb 18‑20) |
| **Quebec** | St. Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 | **No** (Mon 24) – no long weekend |
| **New Brunswick** | New Brunswick Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |
| **Nova Scotia** | Natal Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |
| **Prince Edward Island** | PEI Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |
| **Yukon** | Yukon Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |
| **Northwest Territories** | NWT Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |
| **Nunavut** | Nunavut Day | Aug 7 | **Yes** (Aug 5‑7) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - Store the holiday dates in a `YYYY‑MM‑DD` format.  
> - Flag holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday as “long‑weekend” so you can auto‑generate a 3‑day block.  
> - If you want to support all provinces, keep a separate table of provincial holidays and merge it with the federal list.

Let me know if you’d like the full list of all Canadian holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends) or if you need the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
